title: Approved Providers for the Supply of Wooden Utility Poles in the Electricity Supply Industry in Uganda
text:
Official
APPROVED PROVIDERS FOR THE SUPPLY OF WOODEN UTILITY POLES IN
THE ELECTRICITY SUPPLY INDUSTRY IN UGANDA
The Electricity Regulatory Authority (ERA) was established as a statutory
body in accordance with the Electricity Act Cap. 157 Laws of Uganda. The Act
empowers ERA to regulate the Generation, Transmission, Sale, Export,
Import and Distribution of Electrical Energy in Uganda.
In the Financial Year (FY) 2019/20, the Authority through a participatory
process, conducted a review of the Wooden Pole supply chain in the
Electricity Supply Industry of Uganda. In light of the above, the Authority
approved the Electricity (Acquisition and Use of Wooden Poles in the
Electricity Industry) Guidelines, 2020, to regulate the acquisition of Wooden
Poles in the Electricity Supply Industry of Uganda. The guidelines can be
accessed at https://www.era.go.ug/index.php/resource-centre/regulatory-
instruments/gazette-notices/599-electricity-acquisition-and-use-of-wooden-
poles-in-the-electricity-industry-guidelines-2020. These guidelines became
effective on 1st March 2021.
The guidelines under Clause 5 (b) provide that; “A Licensee shall procure
Wooden Poles from a list of ERA-registered providers”. Accordingly, the
Authority has renewed Wooden Pole providers presented in Table 1 to supply
Wooden Utility Poles in the Electricity Supply Industry in Uganda.

The purpose of this notice is as follows:
1) To bring to the attention of the concerned stakeholders and the
general public the list of ERA-Registered Wooden Pole Providers
eligible to supply wooden utility poles in the Electricity Supply Industry
in Uganda, in accordance with the Electricity (Acquisition and Use of
Wooden Poles in the Electricity Industry) Guidelines, 2020, for the
Financial Years 2024/25 to 2027/28, as presented in Table 1 above.
2) To Direct all ERA Licensees and request all the players and stakeholders
involved in the business of Electricity Supply in Uganda to procure
Wooden Utility Poles from the ERA-Registered Providers only as listed
above.
3) To notify concerned stakeholders and the general public that the above
list of ERA-Registered Providers to supply Wooden Utility Poles in the
Electricity Supply Industry is effective 1st July 2024.
CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
ELECTRICITY REGULATORY AUTHORITY
